correctness.rationale: Uniform recursive-tree fringe counts satisfy E B[N,k]=N/[k(k+1)] and B[N,k]/N concentrates. Bernoulli rare cuts yield independent Poisson means lambda/[k(k+1)], with a uniform 1/(K+1) control of large marked fringes. The expected number of nested cut pairs is O(q_N^2 N log N)=o(1), hence forest component counts coincide asymptotically. Truncation gives the compound Poisson deficit; exact character conditioning gives even-time parity bias 2^{-lambda}, hence total variation 2^{-lambda-1}. An exact independent finite checker passed 63 assertions; asymptotic claims use the complete analytical argument.
